newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Jean-Christophe Filori briefed on Thursday's Transport Council. He said great progress had been made in the negotiations with Switzerland and that there was a hope to conclude in the first half of 1997. He said the ministers agreed to raise the eurovignette price and to have separate prices according to the lorries' weight and pollution rate.

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida briefed on Monday's EU-U.S. summit. He said discussions would focus on the results of the WTO Singapore meeting, trans-Atlantic cooperation, Cuba, the Helms-Burton law and the situation in the Great Lakes area and in the Middle East.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1170: The information society: the European Commission is organizing a multidisciplinary machine-readable data forum.
- IP/96/1171: A multiannual Community programme to help establish the information society in Europe.
- IP/96/1172: The outcome of Singapore, statement by Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan.
- Speech/96/328: Speech by Commissioner Anita Gradin at EP annual debate.
- Speech/96/331: Speech by Commissioner Emma Bonino at EP Inquiry Committee on BSE.
- Memo/96/120: Calendar from December 16 to December 20, 1996.
